rotation_control.prior_probe_limitation: Earlier weight-range and 32-sample probes checked R1 only. Layer-specific R2 differed. Their full-chain rejection remains valid, but method attribution is confounded.
rotation_control.delivery_boundary: Different per-layer R2 matrices are valid when each layer's V/O weights and cache handling are internally consistent. This experiment-control issue does not by itself establish a delivered-model rotation bug.

down_projection.interpretation: One output-channel scale covers 6144 input weights. INT4 approximation loss remains with FP32 operations. This does not prove a hardware limit or explain each MMLU failure.

confirmed_activation_clipping.observation_scope: Internal values captured using actual dequantized INT4 weights with FP32 operations; clipping effect additionally tested in real quantized TFLite graph.

repair.method: Extend selected hidden, MLP and residual INT16 domains by 1.125, preserve domain aliases and refresh zero-bias scales.
repair.decision: reject_global_guard_due_to_lower_mmlu_accuracy; small PPL improvement does not justify delivery replacement

other_repair_attempts.method: Replace only MLP INT4 constants with weight-error optimized constants, preserve attention and all activation parameters.
Activation-aware layer-error qparam optimization, 64 search samples and two existing training calibration batches.
other_repair_attempts.decision: reject_at_local_check; does not establish failure of all configurations

other_repair_attempts.method: Equivalent paired SwiGLU up/down channel balancing, scale capped at 2, fixed original rotation, existing 16 training calibration samples.

board_execution_controls.limit: One question only; does not prove every attention/cache operation correct.

remaining_limitations: Main weight loss was isolated on one late layer and one block; no claim of quantitative whole-model loss attribution.
Removing activation clipping does not restore FP32 weights or reverse preceding-layer accumulated error.
Current evidence does not show that W4A16 optimization has reached its limit.
No W8A16, mixed precision, source-model training or full-dataset evaluation was used.
The same fixed first-round subset is reused for diagnosis and candidate screening; post-diagnosis measurements are not independent held-out validation.
conclusion: Local clipping was reduced, but global range expansion lowered MMLU. No complete W4A16 fix for the main quality gap was obtained. Preserve the current two-DLA delivery; optimization is not proven exhausted.
